newsitem.title: USA: Oriole Homes Q2 sales $25.4 mln vs $23.7mln.
newsitem.headline: Oriole Homes Q2 sales $25.4 mln vs $23.7mln.

text.p: Oriole Homes Corp said Wednesday sales of homes and condominiums closed during the second quarter ended June 30 increased 7 percent to $25.4 million from $23.7 million during the same period a year ago.
The average per unit value of sales closed during the second quarter was $157,071 compared to an average value of $189,640 for the same period a year ago.
Sales of houses and condominiums closed during the six months ended June 30 totaled $45.2 million, representing a 12 percent increase over the $40.4 million for the same period a year ago.
The company entered into new sales contracts valued at $31.5 million compared to $30.5 for the same period a year ago.
Oriole Homes designs, builds and sells homes in Florida.
